using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Text.Json;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.server
{
    public class DefaultRespCommandsDataProviderTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<IStreamProvider> _mockStreamProvider;
        private readonly Mock<ILogger> _mockLogger;
        private readonly DefaultRespCommandsDataProvider<MockRespCommandData> _provider;

        public DefaultRespCommandsDataProviderTests()
        {
            _mockStreamProvider = new Mock<IStreamProvider>();
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            _provider = DefaultRespCommandsDataProvider<MockRespCommandData>.Instance;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryImportRespCommandsData_ValidJson_Succeeds()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "test.json";
            var json = "[{\"Name\":\"TEST\",\"Command\":0}]";
            var stream = new MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(json));
            _mockStreamProvider.Setup(sp => sp.Read(path)).Returns(stream);

            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, MockRespCommandData> result;

            // Act
            var success = _provider.TryImportRespCommandsData(path, _mockStreamProvider.Object, out result, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(success);
            Assert.NotNull(result);
            Assert.Single(result);
            Assert.Equal("TEST", result["test"].Name);
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryImportRespCommandsData_InvalidJson_LogsErrorAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "invalid.json";
            var invalidJson = "invalid json";
            var stream = new MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(invalidJson));
            _mockStreamProvider.Setup(sp => sp.Read(path)).Returns(stream);

            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, MockRespCommandData> result;

            // Act
            var success = _provider.TryImportRespCommandsData(path, _mockStreamProvider.Object, out result, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(success);
            Assert.Null(result);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(s => s.ToString().Contains("An error occurred while parsing resp command data file (Path: {path})")),
                    It.Is<JsonException>(ex => ex.Message.Contains("invalid json")),
                    It.IsAny<Func<JsonException, Exception>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryImportRespCommandsData_NullLogger_DoesNotThrow()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "test.json";
            var invalidJson = "{invalid}";
            var stream = new MemoryStream(System.Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetBytes(invalidJson));
            _mockStreamProvider.Setup(sp => sp.Read(path)).Returns(stream);

            IReadOnlyDictionary<string, MockRespCommandData> result;

            // Act
            var success = _provider.TryImportRespCommandsData(path, _mockStreamProvider.Object, out result, null);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(success);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryExportRespCommandsData_ValidData_Succeeds()
        {
            // Arrange
            var path = "export.json";
            var commandsData = new Dictionary<string, MockRespCommandData>
            {
                ["TEST"] = new MockRespCommandData { Name = "TEST", Command = RespCommand.PING }
            };
            var readOnlyDict = new ReadOnlyDictionary<string, MockRespCommandData>(commandsData);
            _mockStreamProvider.Setup(sp => sp.Write(path, It.IsAny<byte[]>())).Verifiable();

            // Act
            var success = _provider.TryExportRespCommandsData(path, _mockStreamProvider.Object, readOnlyDict, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(success);
            _mockStreamProvider.Verify(sp => sp.Write(path, It.IsAny<byte[]>()), Times.Once);
            _mockLogger.VerifyNoOtherCalls();
        }

        [Fact]
        public void TryExportRespCommandsData_NotSupportedException_LogsErrorAndReturnsFalse()
        {
            // Arrange
            // Create data that will cause NotSupportedException during serialization
            var commandsData = new Dictionary<string, MockRespCommandData>
            {
                ["TEST"] = new MockRespCommandData { Name = "TEST", Command = RespCommand.PING, ProblematicProperty = new object() }
            };
            var readOnlyDict = new ReadOnlyDictionary<string, MockRespCommandData>(commandsData);
            var path = "export.json";
            _mockStreamProvider.Setup(sp => sp.Write(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<byte[]>())).Verifiable();

            // Act
            var success = _provider.TryExportRespCommandsData(path, _mockStreamProvider.Object, readOnlyDict, _mockLogger.Object);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(success);
            _mockStreamProvider.Verify(sp => sp.Write(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<byte[]>()), Times.Never);
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(s => s.ToString().Contains("An error occurred while serializing resp command data file (Path: {path})")),
                    It.Is<NotSupportedException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<NotSupportedException, Exception>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }

    // Mock implementation for testing
    public class MockRespCommandData : IRespCommandData<MockRespCommandData>
    {
        public RespCommand Command { get; init; }
        public string Name { get; init; } = string.Empty;
        public MockRespCommandData[] SubCommands { get; init; } = Array.Empty<MockRespCommandData>();
        public MockRespCommandData Parent { get; set; } = null!;
        public object? ProblematicProperty { get; set; } // Causes NotSupportedException during JSON serialization
    }
}
